scripts.build:libs: npm run build:tokens && npm run build -w @kangaroos/core -w @kangaroos/charts -w @kangaroos/scene
scripts.build: npm run build:libs && npm run build -w @kangaroos/article
scripts.test: npm run build:libs && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:libs && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.dev: npm run build:libs && npm run dev -w @kangaroos/scene
scripts.dev:article: npm run build:libs && npm run dev -w @kangaroos/article
